addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. content.content:
1	# agent_trace_vis
2	
3	A Streamlit-based **agent trace visualizer**. It parses the internal event
4	streams that AI coding agents (opencode, Claude Code) produce during a session
5	and renders per-turn token usage, tool-call timing, context pressure, a
6	sequence diagram, and raw event tables — the analysis an agent author needs to
7	understand where tokens/time actually go.
8	
9	It works in two modes:
10	
11	- **Standalone** — run `streamlit run app.py` and pick a trace file via the
12	  sidebar (for local analysis, debugging, or the Gemini CLI telemetry format).
13	- **Embedded** — when iframed by [Ora](https://github.com/ora-space/desktop),
14	  the URL carries `?session_id=<oraSessionId>&agent_type=<…>` and the app reads
15	  a locator Ora wrote, resolves the trace file, parses it, and renders directly
16	  inside the iframe (no sidebar, no file picker). This is how the in-app
17	  dashboard works.
18	
19	## Supported agent types
20	
21	| `agent_type`  | Source of the trace data                                   | Parser                           |
22	| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
23	| `opencode`    | `~/.local/share/opencode/trace/<session-id>.ndjson`       | `trace_viz/parsers/opencode.py`  |
24	| `claude_code` | `~/.claude/projects/<project-hash>/<session-id>.jsonl`     | `trace_viz/parsers/claude_code.py` |
25	| `gemini`      | Gemini CLI telemetry log (standalone only)                | `trace_viz/parsers/gemini.py`    |
26	
27	`opencode` covers both the `opencode` and `nga` CLIs (same data model);
28	`claude_code` covers Claude Code's interactive transcript JSONL **and** the
29	`-p --output-format stream-json` one-shot format (auto-detected).
30	
31	## Opencode trace-logger plugin (how the `.ndjson` is produced)
32	
33	opencode does **not** write the trace-logger NDJSON natively; the file is
34	produced by a plugin (`plugins/trace_logger.ts`) that subscribes to the opencode
35	event bus and writes one NDJSON line per event.
36	
37	### Install
38	
39	1. Copy the plugin into the opencode plugins directory:
40	
41	   ```bash
42	   mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/plugins
43	   cp plugins/trace_logger.ts ~/.config/opencode/plugins/trace_logger.ts
44	   ```
45	
46	2. (Optional but recommended) Register it in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc`
47	   if your opencode version does not auto-discover plugins in that directory:
48	
49	   ```jsonc
50	   {
51	     "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
52	     "plugin": ["./plugins/trace_logger.ts"]
53	   }
54	   ```
55	
56	3. Start a new opencode session and use it normally. The plugin appends to:
57	
58	   ```
59	   ~/.local/share/opencode/trace/<agent-session-id>.ndjson
60	   ```
61	
62	   one line per event (`session.start`, `step.start`/`step.finish`,
63	   `tool.start`/`tool.finish`, `text.assistant`, `reasoning`, `session.end`,
64	   …). The file is keyed by the opencode session id (`ses_…`).
65	
66	4. Visualize:
67	   - **Standalone** — `streamlit run app.py` → "Opencode" → upload the
68	     `.ndjson` file.
69	   - **Embedded in Ora** — open the Ora dashboard panel for that session; Ora
70	     resolves the file path and the app reads it automatically (no upload).
71	
72	### What the plugin records
73	
74	- **Tokens**: per-step deltas (`tokens{input,output,reasoning,cacheRead,
75	  cacheWrite}`) and cumulative totals (`cumTokens`) on every `step.finish`.
76	- **Tools**: `tool.start`/`tool.finish` with `args`, `output`, `outputSize`,
77	  `isError`, `duration`, normalized `filePath` for file tools, and separated
78	  `stdout`/`stderr` for `bash`.
79	- **Context pressure**: `contextLimit` + `contextPressure` (0–1) so the
80	  dashboard can show how close the session is to the context window.
81	- **Compaction timing**: `compaction.start`/`compaction.complete` with
82	  `tokensBefore`, `tokensFreed`, `compressionRatio`, `duration`.
83	- **Permission wait time**: `permission.asked`/`permission.replied` with
84	  `blockedMs` (how long the agent was blocked on the user).
85	- **Sub-agent spawns, retries, snapshots, file access, patches** — full event
86	  coverage for sequence-diagram and timeline views.
87	
88	## Standalone usage
89	
90	```bash
91	pip install -r requirements.txt
92	streamlit run app.py
93	```
94	
95	Pick a format on the landing page (Opencode / Gemini CLI / Claude Code) and
96	either upload a file or, for Claude Code, browse `~/.claude/projects`.
97	
98	## Embedded usage (Ora integration)
99	
100	When Ora's desktop app iframes this dashboard it opens:
101	
102	```
103	http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?session_id=<oraSessionId>&agent_type=<opencode|claude_code>
104	```
105	
106	Ora has already resolved the trace file path and written a locator to its app
107	data directory:
108	
109	```
110	<appDataDir>/dashboard/<oraSessionId>.json   →   {"traceFilePath": "...", "agentType": "..."}
111	```
112	
113	The app computes that locator root by OS convention (the Ora Tauri identifier
114	`space.ora.desktop`), reads the locator, reads the trace file, parses by
115	`agent_type`, and renders. The private agent session id never leaves Ora's
116	backend; only the resolved file path crosses to the dashboard.
117	
118	The dashboard server itself is **externally managed** — you start Streamlit:
119	
120	```bash
121	streamlit run app.py \
122	  --server.port 8601 \
123	  --server.headless true \
124	  --server.enableCORS false \
125	  --server.enableXsrfProtection false \
126	  --browser.gatherUsageStats false
127	```
128	
129	(the `enableCORS`/`enableXsrfProtection` flags are required for the iframe to
130	load). Ora only knows the configured host:port and embeds it.
131	
132	## Project layout
133	
134	```
135	app.py                         # entry: embedded dispatch + standalone landing page
136	plugins/trace_logger.ts        # opencode plugin that produces the .ndjson
137	trace_viz/
138	  embedded.py                  # locator-root + locator + trace-file + parse dispatch (embedded)
139	  models.py                    # ParseResult / Turn / ToolCall / SessionInfo / ResultInfo
140	  parsers/
141	    opencode.py                # NDJSON → ParseResult (weight-distributed token allotment)
142	    claude_code.py             # transcript JSONL + stream-json → ParseResult
143	    gemini.py                  # Gemini telemetry log → ParseResult
144	  views/
145	    opencode.py                # charts: token trend, allotment, sequence, raw
146	    claude_code.py              # charts: timeline, token trend, cost, raw
147	    gemini.py                  # gemini charts
148	    shared.py                  # render_mermaid, token_trend_fig, tool_inspector, …
149	  utils.py                     # tiktoken count, mermaid sanitization, formatters
150	  config.py                    # palettes, page constants, mermaid CDN
151	sample_opencode.ndjson         # sample for offline testing
152	sample_claude_code.ndjson      # sample for offline testing
153	requirements.txt
154	```
155	
156	## Tests
157	
158	A standalone smoke test of the embedded path (locator read → trace-file read →
159	parse dispatch) runs against the bundled samples without a Streamlit runtime:
160	
161	```bash
162	python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import trace_viz.embedded as e; \
163	  print(e.locator_root())"
164	```
165	
166	## License
167	
168	MIT.

# agent_trace_vis

A Streamlit-based **agent trace visualizer**. It parses the internal event
streams that AI coding agents (opencode, Claude Code) produce during a session
and renders per-turn token usage, tool-call timing, context pressure, a
sequence diagram, and raw event tables — the analysis an agent author needs to
understand where tokens/time actually go.

It works in two modes:

- **Standalone** — run `streamlit run app.py` and pick a trace file via the
  sidebar (for local analysis, debugging, or the Gemini CLI telemetry format).
- **Embedded** — when iframed by [Ora](https://github.com/ora-space/desktop),
  the URL carries `?session_id=<oraSessionId>&agent_type=<…>` and the app reads
  a locator Ora wrote, resolves the trace file, parses it, and renders directly
  inside the iframe (no sidebar, no file picker). This is how the in-app
  dashboard works.

## Supported agent types

| `agent_type`  | Source of the trace data                                   | Parser                           |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `opencode`    | `~/.local/share/opencode/trace/<session-id>.ndjson`       | `trace_viz/parsers/opencode.py`  |
| `claude_code` | `~/.claude/projects/<project-hash>/<session-id>.jsonl`     | `trace_viz/parsers/claude_code.py` |
| `gemini`      | Gemini CLI telemetry log (standalone only)                | `trace_viz/parsers/gemini.py`    |

`opencode` covers both the `opencode` and `nga` CLIs (same data model);
`claude_code` covers Claude Code's interactive transcript JSONL **and** the
`-p --output-format stream-json` one-shot format (auto-detected).

## Opencode trace-logger plugin (how the `.ndjson` is produced)

opencode does **not** write the trace-logger NDJSON natively; the file is
produced by a plugin (`plugins/trace_logger.ts`) that subscribes to the opencode
event bus and writes one NDJSON line per event.

### Install

1. Copy the plugin into the opencode plugins directory:

   ```bash
   mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/plugins
   cp plugins/trace_logger.ts ~/.config/opencode/plugins/trace_logger.ts
   ```

2. (Optional but recommended) Register it in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc`
   if your opencode version does not auto-discover plugins in that directory:

   ```jsonc
   {
     "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
     "plugin": ["./plugins/trace_logger.ts"]
   }
   ```

3. Start a new opencode session and use it normally. The plugin appends to:

   ```
   ~/.local/share/opencode/trace/<agent-session-id>.ndjson
   ```

   one line per event (`session.start`, `step.start`/`step.finish`,
   `tool.start`/`tool.finish`, `text.assistant`, `reasoning`, `session.end`,
   …). The file is keyed by the opencode session id (`ses_…`).

4. Visualize:
   - **Standalone** — `streamlit run app.py` → "Opencode" → upload the
     `.ndjson` file.
   - **Embedded in Ora** — open the Ora dashboard panel for that session; Ora
     resolves the file path and the app reads it automatically (no upload).

### What the plugin records

- **Tokens**: per-step deltas (`tokens{input,output,reasoning,cacheRead,
  cacheWrite}`) and cumulative totals (`cumTokens`) on every `step.finish`.
- **Tools**: `tool.start`/`tool.finish` with `args`, `output`, `outputSize`,
  `isError`, `duration`, normalized `filePath` for file tools, and separated
  `stdout`/`stderr` for `bash`.
- **Context pressure**: `contextLimit` + `contextPressure` (0–1) so the
  dashboard can show how close the session is to the context window.
- **Compaction timing**: `compaction.start`/`compaction.complete` with
  `tokensBefore`, `tokensFreed`, `compressionRatio`, `duration`.
- **Permission wait time**: `permission.asked`/`permission.replied` with
  `blockedMs` (how long the agent was blocked on the user).
- **Sub-agent spawns, retries, snapshots, file access, patches** — full event
  coverage for sequence-diagram and timeline views.

## Standalone usage

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
streamlit run app.py
```

Pick a format on the landing page (Opencode / Gemini CLI / Claude Code) and
either upload a file or, for Claude Code, browse `~/.claude/projects`.

## Embedded usage (Ora integration)

When Ora's desktop app iframes this dashboard it opens:

```
http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?session_id=<oraSessionId>&agent_type=<opencode|claude_code>
```

Ora has already resolved the trace file path and written a locator to its app
data directory:

```
<appDataDir>/dashboard/<oraSessionId>.json   →   {"traceFilePath": "...", "agentType": "..."}
```

The app computes that locator root by OS convention (the Ora Tauri identifier
`space.ora.desktop`), reads the locator, reads the trace file, parses by
`agent_type`, and renders. The private agent session id never leaves Ora's
backend; only the resolved file path crosses to the dashboard.

The dashboard server itself is **externally managed** — you start Streamlit:

```bash
streamlit run app.py \
  --server.port 8601 \
  --server.headless true \
  --server.enableCORS false \
  --server.enableXsrfProtection false \
  --browser.gatherUsageStats false
```

(the `enableCORS`/`enableXsrfProtection` flags are required for the iframe to
load). Ora only knows the configured host:port and embeds it.

## Project layout

```
app.py                         # entry: embedded dispatch + standalone landing page
plugins/trace_logger.ts        # opencode plugin that produces the .ndjson
trace_viz/
  embedded.py                  # locator-root + locator + trace-file + parse dispatch (embedded)
  models.py                    # ParseResult / Turn / ToolCall / SessionInfo / ResultInfo
  parsers/
    opencode.py                # NDJSON → ParseResult (weight-distributed token allotment)
    claude_code.py             # transcript JSONL + stream-json → ParseResult
    gemini.py                  # Gemini telemetry log → ParseResult
  views/
    opencode.py                # charts: token trend, allotment, sequence, raw
    claude_code.py              # charts: timeline, token trend, cost, raw
    gemini.py                  # gemini charts
    shared.py                  # render_mermaid, token_trend_fig, tool_inspector, …
  utils.py                     # tiktoken count, mermaid sanitization, formatters
  config.py                    # palettes, page constants, mermaid CDN
sample_opencode.ndjson         # sample for offline testing
sample_claude_code.ndjson      # sample for offline testing
requirements.txt
```

## Tests

A standalone smoke test of the embedded path (locator read → trace-file read →
parse dispatch) runs against the bundled samples without a Streamlit runtime:

```bash
python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import trace_viz.embedded as e; \
  print(e.locator_root())"
```

"""Trace Visualizer — entry point.

Run with:  streamlit run app.py

When iframed by Ora the URL carries ?session_id=<oraSessionId> and
?agent_type=<opencode|claude_code>; Ora has already resolved the trace file
and written a locator. That embedded path bypasses the landing page and the
sidebar data-source pickers, rendering the trace directly.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import streamlit as st

from trace_viz import embedded
from trace_viz.views import claude_code as cc_view
from trace_viz.views import gemini as gem_view
from trace_viz.views import opencode as oc_view

# Maps the canonical agent_type Ora hands the dashboard to the view whose
# render_body should draw the parsed trace. agent_type values mirror app_mode.
EMBEDDED_VIEWS = {
    "opencode": oc_view.render_body,
    "claude_code": cc_view.render_body,
}


def render_embedded(session_id: str, agent_type: str) -> None:
    """Renders one Ora-resolved trace inside the iframe, hiding the standalone sidebar."""
    # Collapse Streamlit's own sidebar so the embedded view has the full width;
    # the standalone file pickers are not used in embedded mode.
    st.markdown(
        "<style>[data-testid='stSidebarCollapsedControl'],"
        "[data-testid='stSidebar'][aria-expanded='false']{display:none !important;}</style>",
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )

    locator = embedded.load_locator(session_id)
    if locator is None:
        st.warning(
            "定位器尚未生成。请先在 Ora 中打开该会话的 dashboard，让 Ora 解析并写入 trace 文件路径。"
        )
        return
    if locator.agent_type != agent_type:
        st.error(
            f"agent_type 不一致：URL 为 {agent_type}，定位器为 {locator.agent_type}。"
        )
        return
    content = embedded.read_trace_bytes(locator)
    if content is None:
        st.info("trace 文件尚未生成或为空——会话进行中或尚未产生事件，稍后再试。")
        return
    result = embedded.parse_for_agent_type(content, agent_type)
    if result is None:
        st.error(f"不支持的 agent_type：{agent_type}")
        return
    if not result.raw_events:
        st.warning("已读取 trace 文件，但未解析到任何事件。")
        return
    render_body = EMBEDDED_VIEWS.get(agent_type)
    if render_body is None:
        st.error(f"无嵌入渲染器对应 agent_type：{agent_type}")
        return
    render_body(result)


st.set_page_config(page_title="Trace Visualizer", layout="wide")

# ── Embedded dispatch (Ora iframe) ──────────────────────────────
_query = st.query_params
_embedded_session_id = _query.get("session_id") or (_query.get("sessionId") if isinstance(_query, dict) else None)
_embedded_agent_type = _query.get("agent_type") or (_query.get("agentType") if isinstance(_query, dict) else None)
if _embedded_session_id and _embedded_agent_type:
    render_embedded(_embedded_session_id, _embedded_agent_type)
    st.stop()

# ── Session state defaults ─────────────────────────────────────
if "app_mode" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.app_mode = None

# ── Global sidebar: back navigation ───────────────────────────
if st.session_state.app_mode is not None:
    with st.sidebar:
        if st.button("← 返回选择页", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state.clear()
            st.rerun()
        st.divider()

# ── Landing page ───────────────────────────────────────────────
if st.session_state.app_mode is None:
    st.title("Trace Visualizer")
    st.caption("选择要分析的日志格式")
    st.markdown("---")

    col1, col2, col3 = st.columns(3)

    with col1:
        st.markdown("#### Opencode")
        st.markdown("trace-logger 生成的 `.ndjson` 文件")
        if st.button("Opencode 可视化", key="btn_oc", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state.app_mode = "opencode"
            st.rerun()

    with col2:
        st.markdown("#### Gemini CLI")
        st.markdown("`GEMINI_TELEMETRY_TRACES_ENABLED` 生成的 telemetry.log")
        if st.button("Gemini CLI 可视化", key="btn_gem", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state.app_mode = "gemini"
            st.rerun()

    with col3:
        st.markdown("#### Claude Code")
        st.markdown("`--output-format stream-json` 生成的流式 NDJSON")
        if st.button("Claude Code 可视化", key="btn_cc", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state.app_mode = "claude_code"
            st.rerun()

    st.stop()

# ── Dispatch ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
mode = st.session_state.app_mode
if mode == "opencode":
    oc_view.render()
elif mode == "gemini":
    gem_view.render()
elif mode == "claude_code":
    cc_view.render()
else:
    st.session_state.app_mode = None
    st.rerun()

"""Typed data models shared across all parsers and views."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class ToolCall:
    """A single tool invocation with its input, output, and computed metrics."""

    name: str
    input: dict[str, Any]
    output: str
    is_error: bool
    turn_no: int
    call_idx: int           # 0-based sequential index across the session

    # Computed fields (populated by parsers)
    tiktoken_tokens: int = 0
    output_chars: int = 0
    duration_ms: float = 0.0
    file_path: str = ""

    # Opencode-specific: weight-distributed token cost
    allotted_tokens: int = 0


@dataclass
class Turn:
    """A single LLM inference call with token usage."""

    turn_no: int
    input_tokens: int       # total context window sent (cumulative)
    output_tokens: int

    cache_read: int = 0
    cache_creation: int = 0
    stop_reason: str = ""
    text_content: str = ""
    tool_count: int = 0
    model: str = ""

    # Opencode-specific
    reasoning_tokens: int = 0


@dataclass
class SessionInfo:
    """Metadata about the agent session."""

    model: str = ""
    session_id: str = ""
    tools_available: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    title: str = ""
    permission_mode: str = ""


@dataclass
class ResultInfo:
    """Aggregated session outcome and totals."""

    duration_ms: int = 0
    duration_api_ms: int = 0
    num_turns: int = 0
    total_cost_usd: float = 0.0
    is_error: bool = False
    result_text: str = ""

    total_input: int = 0
    total_output: int = 0
    total_cache_creation: int = 0
    total_cache_read: int = 0


@dataclass
class ParseResult:
    """Fully parsed session data returned by every parser."""

    source: str                         # "opencode" | "gemini" | "claude_code"
    raw_events: list[dict[str, Any]]
    session_info: SessionInfo
    result_info: ResultInfo
    turns: list[Turn]
    tool_calls: list[ToolCall]

    parse_errors: int = 0
    parse_debug: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    subagents: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

    # ── Convenience properties ─────────────────────────────────
    @property
    def peak_input_tokens(self) -> int:
        if self.result_info.total_input:
            return self.result_info.total_input
        return max((t.input_tokens for t in self.turns), default=0)

    @property
    def total_cost_usd(self) -> float:
        return self.result_info.total_cost_usd

    @property
    def duration_s(self) -> float:
        return self.result_info.duration_ms / 1000

    @staticmethod
    def empty(source: str) -> "ParseResult":
        return ParseResult(
            source=source,
            raw_events=[],
            session_info=SessionInfo(),
            result_info=ResultInfo(),
            turns=[],
            tool_calls=[],
        )

"""Application-wide constants, color palettes, and UI settings."""

from __future__ import annotations

# ── UI constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────

"""Embedded rendering entry point for the Trace Visualizer.

When the dashboard is iframed by Ora, the URL carries `?session_id=<oraSessionId>`
and `?agent_type=<opencode|claude_code>`. Ora has already resolved the Ora session
id to a concrete trace file path and written a small **locator** JSON to the
conventional Ora app-data directory:

    <appDataDir>/dashboard/<oraSessionId>.json   ->  {"traceFilePath": "...", "agentType": "..."}

This module owns the embedded side of that contract: it computes the locator
root by OS convention (mirroring Ora's `app_data_dir`), reads the locator, reads
the trace file bytes, dispatches the matching parser, and hands the
`ParseResult` to the view's body renderer. It is deliberately free of Streamlit
side effects so the locator/parse path is unit-testable without a running app.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Optional

from trace_viz.models import ParseResult
from trace_viz.parsers import claude_code as cc_parser
from trace_viz.parsers import opencode as oc_parser

# Mirrors the Ora desktop Tauri identifier so both sides resolve the same
# app-data directory without per-request coordination (decision: the locator
# root is a conventional path, not a URL/env parameter).
ORA_APP_IDENTIFIER = "space.ora.desktop"
LOCATOR_SUBDIR = "dashboard"


# ── Locator root ───────────────────────────────────────────────


def locator_root() -> Path:
    """Returns the conventional directory where Ora writes dashboard locators.

    Mirrors Ora's Tauri `app_data_dir` for the `space.ora.desktop` identifier so
    the dashboard and Ora agree on a path without any URL or env-var handoff.
    Only consulted when embedded (a `session_id` query param is present); the
    standalone/gemini flow never calls this.
    """
    home = Path.home()
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        base = os.environ.get("APPDATA")
        if base:
            return Path(base) / ORA_APP_IDENTIFIER / LOCATOR_SUBDIR
        # Defensive: APPDATA is effectively always set on Windows; fall back to
        # the Roaming profile under the user home if an exotic environment omits it.
        return home / "AppData" / "Roaming" / ORA_APP_IDENTIFIER / LOCATOR_SUBDIR
    if sys.platform == "darwin":
        return home / "Library" / "Application Support" / ORA_APP_IDENTIFIER / LOCATOR_SUBDIR
    # Linux / other POSIX: XDG data home, defaulting to ~/.local/share.
    xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME")
    base = Path(xdg) if xdg and Path(xdg).is_absolute() else home / ".local" / "share"
    return base / ORA_APP_IDENTIFIER / LOCATOR_SUBDIR


# ── Locator + trace loading ───────────────────────────────────


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Locator:
    """The Ora-written handoff that points the dashboard at a concrete trace file."""

    trace_file_path: str
    agent_type: str


def load_locator(session_id: str, root: Optional[Path] = None) -> Optional[Locator]:
    """Reads and decodes the locator Ora wrote for one Ora session id.

    Returns None when the locator is absent so the caller can surface a friendly
    "trace not ready" state instead of crashing the embedded iframe.
    """
    root = root if root is not None else locator_root()
    locator_path = root / f"{session_id}.json"
    if not locator_path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        payload = json.loads(locator_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    trace_file_path = payload.get("traceFilePath")
    agent_type = payload.get("agentType")
    if not isinstance(trace_file_path, str) or not isinstance(agent_type, str):
        return None
    return Locator(trace_file_path=trace_file_path, agent_type=agent_type)


def read_trace_bytes(locator: Locator) -> Optional[bytes]:
    """Reads the resolved trace file, returning None when it is not yet on disk."""
    path = Path(locator.trace_file_path)
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        return path.read_bytes()
    except OSError:
        return None


# ── Parse dispatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────

# Canonical agent_type -> (parser, view module). agent_type values are the same
# strings Ora normalizes its AgentCli enum into before writing the locator, and
# match the dashboard's existing app_mode dispatch, so no extra mapping is needed.
def _parse_opencode(content: bytes) -> ParseResult:
    return oc_parser.parse(content)


def _parse_claude_code(content: bytes) -> ParseResult:
    return cc_parser.parse(content)


PARSE_DISPATCH: dict[str, Callable[[bytes], ParseResult]] = {
    "opencode": _parse_opencode,
    "claude_code": _parse_claude_code,
}


def parse_for_agent_type(content: bytes, agent_type: str) -> Optional[ParseResult]:
    """Dispatches bytes to the parser for the given canonical agent_type."""
    parser = PARSE_DISPATCH.get(agent_type)
    if parser is None:
        return None
    return parser(content)

2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	import os
7	from functools import lru_cache
8	from typing import Any
9	
10	import tiktoken
11	import tiktoken.load
12	
13	# ── Tiktoken encoder (loaded from local cache if available) ────
14	_CACHE_PATH = os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/tiktoken/cl100k_base.tiktoken")
15	_ENCODER: tiktoken.Encoding | None = None
16	
17	if os.path.exists(_CACHE_PATH):
18	    try:
19	        _ranks = tiktoken.load.load_tiktoken_bpe(_CACHE_PATH)
20	        _ENCODER = tiktoken.Encoding(
21	            name="cl100k_base",
22	            pat_str=(
23	                r"(?i:[sdmt]|ll|ve|re)|[^\n\pL\pP\p{Nd}\p{Sc}\p{Sk}\p{So}]+"
24	                r"|\p{Nd}+|\p{Sc}[\p{Nd}]*|\p{Sc}+|\p{Sk}+|\p{So}+"
25	                r"|\p{Ll}\p{Lo}|\p{L}\p{L}\p{L}*\p{Ll}\p{Lo}"
26	            ),
27	            mergeable_ranks=_ranks,
28	            special_tokens={
29	                "<|endoftext|>": 100257,
30	                "<|fim_prefix|>": 100258,
31	                "<|fim_middle|>": 100259,
32	                "<|fim_suffix|>": 100260,
33	                "<|endofprompt|>": 100276,
34	            },
35	        )
36	    except Exception:
37	        pass
38	
39	
40	@lru_cache(maxsize=4096)
41	def count_tokens(text: str) -> int:
42	    """Approximate token count via cl100k_base; falls back to len/4."""
43	    if not text:
44	        return 0
45	    if _ENCODER is not None:
46	        return len(_ENCODER.encode(text, disallowed_special=()))
47	    return max(1, len(text) // 4)
48	
49	
50	# ── Text helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
51	
52	def to_str(value: Any) -> str:
53	    """Coerce any value (bytes, dict, list, None) to a plain string."""
54	    if value is None:
55	        return ""
56	    if isinstance(value, bytes):
57	        return value.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
58	    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
59	        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
60	    return str(value)
61	
62	
63	_MERMAID_TABLE = str.maketrans({
64	    # ASCII straight quotes collapse to single quotes so they cannot prematurely close
65	    # the outer double-quoted label Mermaid wraps the sanitized text in.
66	    '"': "'",
67	    ":": "：", "\n": " ", "[": "(", "]": ")",
68	    ";": ",", "#": "", "<": "＜", ">": "＞", "&": "＆",
69	    # Curly/smart/fullwidth quotes are NOT caught by the ASCII mapping above; left
70	    # unescaped they terminate Mermaid's double-quoted label mid-string and surface
71	    # as "Syntax error in text" in the sequence diagram. Normalize all of them to
72	    # ASCII single quotes so agent-generated prose (which freely uses "smart quotes")
73	    # renders safely inside a Mermaid message label.
74	    "\u201c": "'",  # left double quotation mark "
75	    "\u201d": "'",  # right double quotation mark "
76	    "\u201e": "'",  # double low-9 quotation mark „
77	    "\u201f": "'",  # double high-reversed-9 quotation mark ‟
78	    "\uff02": "'",  # fullwidth quotation mark ＂
79	    "\u2018": "'",  # left single quotation mark '
80	    "\u2019": "'",  # right single quotation mark '
81	    "\u201a": "'",  # single low-9 quotation mark ‚
82	    "\u201b": "'",  # single high-reversed-9 quotation mark ‛
83	})
84	
85	
86	def sanitize_mermaid(text: str, max_len: int = 50) -> str:
87	    """Make a string safe for use in a Mermaid diagram label."""
88	    text = to_str(text).strip().translate(_MERMAID_TABLE)
89	    return (text[:max_len] + "…") if len(text) > max_len else text
90	
91	
92	def mermaid_quote(text: Any) -> str:
93	    """Return a Mermaid-safe double-quoted label."""
94	    return f'"{sanitize_mermaid(to_str(text))}"'
95	
96	
97	def format_duration(ms: int | float) -> str:
98	    """Human-readable duration from milliseconds."""
99	    if not ms:
100	        return "—"
101	    s = ms / 1000
102	    if s < 60:
103	        return f"{s:.1f}s"
104	    m, rem = divmod(int(s), 60)
105	    return f"{m}m {rem}s"
106	
107	
108	def decode_bytes(content: bytes) -> str | None:
109	    """Try common encodings in order; return None if all fail."""
110	    for enc in ("utf-8", "utf-8-sig", "utf-16", "latin-1"):
111	        try:
112	            return content.decode(enc)
113	        except (UnicodeDecodeError, Exception):
114	            continue
115	    return None

We render into a temp HTML file and embed it with ``st.iframe(height="content")``. Streamlit then measures the iframe's real content height (the rendered svg) and sizes both the iframe and its wrapper to exactly that height, so the sections below ("复制 Mermaid 源码", "单个工具深度诊断") sit flush against the diagram - no overlap (diagram never taller than its box), no gap (never shorter), and the diagram keeps its natural aspect ratio so it stays readable. Previous attempts used ``components.html`` with a fixed Python height estimate: the estimate never matched the real svg height, so a tall diagram overflowed its Streamlit-owned wrapper and bled into the sections below (overlap), while a short one left a gap; stretching the svg with height:100% "fixed" the overlap but scaled the diagram down until session_end boxes were unreadable. The temp-file + st.iframe(height="content") path lets Streamlit own the height and keep it right. The HTML is written to a file (not passed inline) because st.iframe embeds inline HTML via srcdoc, and the minified mermaid CDN contains characters that break that embedding ("Invalid or unexpected token"); a real file loads normally. Mermaid's ``startOnLoad``/``run`` path renders into a transient detached container and fails inside the iframe with "svg element not in render tree", which Mermaid masks as the generic "Syntax error in text" error svg. 1	"""Parser for Claude Code output files.
2	
3	Supports two formats automatically:
4	
5	1. **stream-json** — produced by `claude -p "task" --output-format stream-json`
6	   Events: system | assistant | user (wraps tool_result) | result
7	
8	2. **transcript JSONL** — saved automatically to ~/.claude/projects/<hash>/<session>.jsonl
9	   during every interactive session.
10	   Events: user | assistant | tool_result (top-level, NOT nested inside user)
11	   Each line also carries: uuid, parentUuid, timestamp, sessionId, cwd, version
12	
13	Auto-detection: if ≥ 3 of the first 10 lines contain both "uuid" and "timestamp"
14	keys → transcript format; otherwise → stream-json format.
15	"""
16	
17	from __future__ import annotations
18	
19	import json
20	from datetime import datetime, timezone
21	from typing import Any
22	
23	import streamlit as st
24	
25	from trace_viz.models import ParseResult, ResultInfo, SessionInfo, ToolCall, Turn
26	from trace_viz.utils import count_tokens, to_str
27	
28	
29	@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
30	def parse(content: bytes) -> ParseResult:
31	    """Parse Claude Code NDJSON bytes, auto-detecting format."""
32	    raw_events = _load_ndjson(content)
33	    if not raw_events:
34	        return ParseResult.empty("claude_code")
35	
36	    # ── Format detection ───────────────────────────────────────
37	    transcript_hits = sum(
38	        1 for e in raw_events[:10]
39	        if "uuid" in e and "timestamp" in e
40	    )
41	    if transcript_hits >= 3:
42	        return _parse_transcript(raw_events)
43	    return _parse_stream_json(raw_events)
44	
45	
46	# ── Shared NDJSON loader ───────────────────────────────────────
47	
48	def _load_ndjson(content: bytes) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
49	    events: list[dict] = []
50	    for line in content.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
51	        line = line.strip()
52	        if line:
53	            try:
54	                events.append(json.loads(line))
55	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
56	                pass
57	    return events
58	
59	
60	# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
61	# FORMAT 1 — stream-json  (produced by -p / --print)
62	# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
63	
64	def _parse_stream_json(raw_events: list[dict]) -> ParseResult:
65	    session_info = _sj_session_info(raw_events)
66	    result_info  = _sj_result_info(raw_events)
67	
68	    tool_map: dict[str, dict] = {}
69	    turns: list[Turn] = []
70	    _sj_collect_assistant(raw_events, turns, tool_map)
71	    _sj_match_tool_results(raw_events, tool_map)
72	    tool_calls = _sj_flatten_tool_calls(raw_events, tool_map)
73	
74	    return ParseResult(
75	        source="claude_code",
76	        raw_events=raw_events,
77	        session_info=session_info,
78	        result_info=result_info,
79	        turns=turns,
80	        tool_calls=tool_calls,
81	        parse_debug={"format": "stream-json"},
82	    )
83	
84	
85	def _sj_session_info(events: list[dict]) -> SessionInfo:
86	    for evt in events:
87	        if evt.get("type") == "system":
88	            return SessionInfo(
89	                model=evt.get("model", ""),
90	                session_id=evt.get("session_id", ""),
91	                permission_mode=evt.get("permissionMode", ""),
92	                tools_available=[
93	                    (t.get("name", str(t)) if isinstance(t, dict) else str(t))
94	                    for t in evt.get("tools", [])
95	                ],
96	            )
97	    return SessionInfo()
98	
99	
100	def _sj_result_info(events: list[dict]) -> ResultInfo:
101	    for evt in events:
102	        if evt.get("type") == "result":
103	            usage = evt.get("usage", {})
104	            return ResultInfo(
105	                duration_ms=evt.get("duration_ms", 0) or 0,
106	                duration_api_ms=evt.get("duration_api_ms", 0) or 0,
107	                num_turns=evt.get("num_turns", 0) or 0,
108	                total_cost_usd=evt.get("total_cost_usd") or 0.0,
109	                is_error=bool(evt.get("is_error", False)),
110	                result_text=evt.get("result", ""),
111	                total_input=usage.get("input_tokens", 0) or 0,
112	                total_output=usage.get("output_tokens", 0) or 0,
113	                total_cache_creation=usage.get("cache_creation_input_tokens", 0) or 0,
114	                total_cache_read=usage.get("cache_read_input_tokens", 0) or 0,
115	            )
116	    return ResultInfo()
117	
118	
119	def _sj_collect_assistant(
120	    events: list[dict],
121	    turns: list[Turn],
122	    tool_map: dict[str, dict],
123	) -> None:
124	    for evt in events:
125	        if evt.get("type") != "assistant":
126	            continue
127	        msg   = evt.get("message", {})
128	        usage = msg.get("usage", {})
129	        turn_no = len(turns) + 1
130	        text_parts, tool_count = [], 0
131	
132	        raw_content = msg.get("content", [])
133	        if isinstance(raw_content, str):
134	            raw_content = [{"type": "text", "text": raw_content}]
135	        for block in raw_content:
136	            if not isinstance(block, dict):
137	                continue
138	            if block.get("type") == "text":
139	                text_parts.append(block.get("text", ""))
140	            elif block.get("type") == "tool_use":
141	                tool_count += 1
142	                tid = block.get("id", "")
143	                tool_map[tid] = {
144	                    "id": tid, "name": block.get("name", ""),
145	                    "input": block.get("input") or {}, "turn_no": turn_no,
146	                    "call_idx": len(tool_map), "output": None, "is_error": False,
147	                    "ts_start": None, "ts_end": None,
148	                }
149	
150	        turns.append(Turn(
151	            turn_no=turn_no,
152	            input_tokens=usage.get("input_tokens", 0) or 0,
153	            output_tokens=usage.get("output_tokens", 0) or 0,
154	            cache_read=usage.get("cache_read_input_tokens", 0) or 0,
155	            cache_creation=usage.get("cache_creation_input_tokens", 0) or 0,
156	            stop_reason=msg.get("stop_reason", ""),
157	            text_content="\n".join(text_parts),
158	            tool_count=tool_count,
159	            model=msg.get("model", ""),
160	        ))
161	
162	
163	def _sj_match_tool_results(
164	    events: list[dict], tool_map: dict[str, dict]
165	) -> None:
166	    for evt in events:
167	        if evt.get("type") != "user":
168	            continue
169	        for block in evt.get("message", {}).get("content", []):
170	            if block.get("type") != "tool_result":
171	                continue
172	            tid = block.get("tool_use_id", "")
173	            if tid not in tool_map:
174	                continue
175	            content = block.get("content", "")
176	            if isinstance(content, list):
177	                content = "\n".join(
178	                    (c.get("text", str(c)) if isinstance(c, dict) else str(c))
179	                    for c in content
180	                )
181	            tool_map[tid]["output"]   = content
182	            tool_map[tid]["is_error"] = bool(block.get("is_error", False))
183	
184	
185	def _sj_flatten_tool_calls(
186	    events: list[dict], tool_map: dict[str, dict]
187	) -> list[ToolCall]:
188	    calls, seen = [], set()
189	    for evt in events:
190	        if evt.get("type") != "assistant":
191	            continue
192	        for block in evt.get("message", {}).get("content", []):
193	            if block.get("type") != "tool_use":
194	                continue
195	            tid = block.get("id", "")
196	            if tid in seen or tid not in tool_map:
197	                continue
198	            seen.add(tid)
199	            tc   = tool_map[tid]
200	            text = to_str(tc.get("output") or "")
201	            calls.append(ToolCall(
202	                name=tc["name"], input=tc["input"], output=text,
203	                is_error=tc["is_error"], turn_no=tc["turn_no"],
204	                call_idx=tc["call_idx"],
205	                tiktoken_tokens=count_tokens(text),
206	                output_chars=len(text),
207	            ))
208	    return calls
209	
210	
211	# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
212	# FORMAT 2 — transcript JSONL  (~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl)
213	# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
214	
215	def _parse_transcript(raw_events: list[dict]) -> ParseResult:
216	    """Parse the persistent JSONL transcripts saved by interactive sessions."""
217	
218	    # ── Session metadata from any event ───────────────────────
219	    session_id = next((e.get("sessionId", "") for e in raw_events if e.get("sessionId")), "")
220	    cwd        = next((e.get("cwd",       "") for e in raw_events if e.get("cwd")),       "")
221	    version    = next((e.get("version",   "") for e in raw_events if e.get("version")),   "")
222	
223	    tool_map: dict[str, dict] = {}   # tool_use id → record
224	    turns:      list[Turn]     = []
225	    model = ""
226	
227	    # ── Pass 1: assistant messages → turns + tool_use entries ─
228	    for evt in raw_events:
229	        if evt.get("type") != "assistant":
230	            continue
231	        msg = evt.get("message", {})
232	        if not isinstance(msg, dict):
233	            continue
234	
235	        usage    = msg.get("usage", {})
236	        turn_no  = len(turns) + 1
237	        if not model:
238	            model = msg.get("model", "")
239	
240	        text_parts, tool_count = [], 0
241	        raw_content = msg.get("content", [])
242	        # content may be a plain string, a list of dicts, or a list of strings
243	        if isinstance(raw_content, str):
244	            raw_content = [{"type": "text", "text": raw_content}]
245	        for block in raw_content:
246	            if isinstance(block, str):
247	                text_parts.append(block)
248	                continue
249	            if not isinstance(block, dict):
250	                continue
251	            btype = block.get("type", "")
252	            if btype == "text":
253	                text_parts.append(block.get("text", ""))
254	            elif btype == "tool_use":
255	                tool_count += 1
256	                tid = block.get("id", "")
257	                tool_map[tid] = {
258	                    "id":        tid,
259	                    "name":      block.get("name", ""),
260	                    "input":     block.get("input") or {},
261	                    "turn_no":   turn_no,
262	                    "call_idx":  len(tool_map),
263	                    "output":    None,
264	                    "is_error":  False,
265	                    # timestamps from the wrapping event
266	                    "ts_start":  evt.get("timestamp"),
267	                    "ts_end":    None,
268	                }
269	
270	        turns.append(Turn(
271	            turn_no=turn_no,
272	            input_tokens=usage.get("input_tokens", 0) or 0,
273	            output_tokens=usage.get("output_tokens", 0) or 0,
274	            cache_read=usage.get("cache_read_input_tokens", 0) or 0,
275	            cache_creation=usage.get("cache_creation_input_tokens", 0) or 0,
276	            stop_reason=msg.get("stop_reason", ""),
277	            text_content="\n".join(text_parts),
278	            tool_count=tool_count,
279	            model=msg.get("model", ""),
280	        ))
281	
282	    # ── Pass 2: tool_result blocks nested inside user messages ──
283	    # Transcript JSONL uses the same structure as stream-json:
284	    # tool results are wrapped inside type:"user" message.content blocks.
285	    # The "tool_use_id" key may be snake_case or camelCase depending on version.
286	    for evt in raw_events:
287	        if evt.get("type") != "user":
288	            continue
289	        evt_ts = evt.get("timestamp")  # timestamp for this tool result delivery
290	        msg    = evt.get("message") or {}
291	        if not isinstance(msg, dict):
292	            continue
293	        raw_content = msg.get("content", [])
294	        if isinstance(raw_content, str):
295	            continue
296	        for block in raw_content:
297	            if not isinstance(block, dict):
298	                continue
299	            if block.get("type") != "tool_result":
300	                continue
301	            # Support both naming conventions
302	            tid = (block.get("tool_use_id")
303	                   or block.get("toolUseId")
304	                   or "")
305	            if tid not in tool_map:
306	                continue
307	            raw = block.get("content", "")
308	            if isinstance(raw, list):
309	                raw = "\n".join(
310	                    (c.get("text", str(c)) if isinstance(c, dict) else str(c))
311	                    for c in raw
312	                )
313	            tool_map[tid]["output"]   = to_str(raw)
314	            tool_map[tid]["is_error"] = bool(block.get("is_error", False))
315	            tool_map[tid]["ts_end"]   = evt_ts
316	
317	    # ── Flatten tool calls in stream order ─────────────────────
318	    tool_calls, seen = [], set()
319	    for evt in raw_events:
320	        if evt.get("type") != "assistant":
321	            continue
322	        for block in evt.get("message", {}).get("content", []):
323	            if block.get("type") != "tool_use":
324	                continue
325	            tid = block.get("id", "")
326	            if tid in seen or tid not in tool_map:
327	                continue
328	            seen.add(tid)
329	            tc   = tool_map[tid]
330	            text = to_str(tc.get("output") or "")
331	            tool_calls.append(ToolCall(
332	                name=tc["name"], input=tc["input"], output=text,
333	                is_error=tc["is_error"], turn_no=tc["turn_no"],
334	                call_idx=tc["call_idx"],
335	                tiktoken_tokens=count_tokens(text),
336	                output_chars=len(text),
337	                duration_ms=_ts_delta_ms(tc.get("ts_start"), tc.get("ts_end")),
338	            ))
339	
340	    # ── Result info ────────────────────────────────────────────
341	    result_info = ResultInfo(num_turns=len(turns))
342	    if turns:
343	        result_info.total_input  = turns[-1].input_tokens
344	        result_info.total_output = sum(t.output_tokens for t in turns)
345	        result_info.total_cache_read     = turns[-1].cache_read
346	        result_info.total_cache_creation = turns[-1].cache_creation
347	
348	    timestamps = [e.get("timestamp") for e in raw_events if e.get("timestamp")]
349	    if len(timestamps) >= 2:
350	        result_info.duration_ms = int(
351	            _ts_delta_ms(timestamps[0], timestamps[-1])
352	        )
353	
354	    session_info = SessionInfo(
355	        model=model,
356	        session_id=session_id,
357	        title=cwd,          # repurpose title to show the working directory
358	        tools_available=[],
359	    )
360	
361	    return ParseResult(
362	        source="claude_code",
363	        raw_events=raw_events,
364	        session_info=session_info,
365	        result_info=result_info,
366	        turns=turns,
367	        tool_calls=tool_calls,
368	        parse_debug={"format": "transcript", "cwd": cwd, "version": version},
369	    )
370	
371	
372	# ── Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
373	
374	def _ts_delta_ms(ts_start: str | None, ts_end: str | None) -> float:
375	    """Return millisecond delta between two ISO-8601 timestamp strings."""
376	    if not ts_start or not ts_end:
377	        return 0.0
378	    try:
379	        t1 = datetime.fromisoformat(ts_start.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
380	        t2 = datetime.fromisoformat(ts_end.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
381	        return max(0.0, (t2 - t1).total_seconds() * 1000)
382	    except Exception:
383	        return 0.0
384

1	"""Parser for Opencode trace-logger `.ndjson` files.
2	
3	Key algorithm: weight-based token allotment.
4	  When multiple tools run in the same globalStep, the input-token delta
5	  for that step is distributed among them proportionally by their
6	  tiktoken output size.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import json
12	import re
13	from collections import deque
14	from typing import Any
15	
16	import streamlit as st
17	
18	from trace_viz.models import ParseResult, ResultInfo, SessionInfo, ToolCall, Turn
19	from trace_viz.utils import count_tokens, to_str
20	
21	
22	@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
23	def parse(content: bytes) -> ParseResult:
24	    """Parse Opencode NDJSON content and return a structured ParseResult."""
25	    raw_events = _load_ndjson(content)
26	    if not raw_events:
27	        return ParseResult.empty("opencode")
28	
29	    session_info = _extract_session_info(raw_events)
30	    turns = _extract_turns(raw_events)
31	    tool_calls = _extract_tool_calls(raw_events, turns)
32	    result_info = _build_result_info(raw_events, turns)
33	    subagents = _extract_subagents(raw_events)
34	
35	    return ParseResult(
36	        source="opencode",
37	        raw_events=raw_events,
38	        session_info=session_info,
39	        result_info=result_info,
40	        turns=turns,
41	        tool_calls=tool_calls,
42	        subagents=subagents,
43	    )
44	
45	
46	# ── Private helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────
47	
48	def _load_ndjson(content: bytes) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
49	    events: list[dict] = []
50	    for line in content.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
51	        line = line.strip()
52	        if line:
53	            try:
54	                events.append(json.loads(line))
55	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
56	                pass
57	    return events
58	
59	
60	def _extract_session_info(events: list[dict]) -> SessionInfo:
61	    for evt in events:
62	        if evt.get("type") == "session.start":
63	            return SessionInfo(
64	                model=evt.get("model", ""),
65	                session_id=evt.get("sessionID", ""),
66	                title=evt.get("title", ""),
67	            )
68	    return SessionInfo()
69	
70	
71	def _extract_turns(events: list[dict]) -> list[Turn]:
72	    turns: list[Turn] = []
73	    for evt in events:
74	        if evt.get("type") != "step.finish":
75	            continue
76	        turns.append(Turn(
77	            turn_no=evt["globalStep"],
78	            input_tokens=evt["cumTokens"]["input"],
79	            output_tokens=evt["cumTokens"]["output"],
80	            reasoning_tokens=evt["tokens"].get("reasoning", 0),
81	            cache_read=evt["tokens"].get("cacheRead", 0),
82	            cache_creation=evt["tokens"].get("cacheWrite", 0),
83	            stop_reason=evt.get("reason", ""),
84	        ))
85	    return turns
86	
87	
88	def _extract_tool_calls(
89	    events: list[dict], turns: list[Turn]
90	) -> list[ToolCall]:
91	    # Build lookup maps
92	    step_map: dict[int, Turn] = {t.turn_no: t for t in turns}
93	    tool_start_map: dict[str, dict] = {
94	        e["toolCallId"]: e for e in events if e.get("type") == "tool.start"
95	    }
96	    finishes = [e for e in events if e.get("type") == "tool.finish"]
97	
98	    # Pre-compute tiktoken tokens per finish event (needed for weight calculation)
99	    finish_tokens: list[int] = [
100	        count_tokens(to_str(e.get("output", ""))) for e in finishes
101	    ]
102	
103	    # Group finish indices by globalStep for parallel-tool weighting
104	    step_to_indices: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
105	    for idx, evt in enumerate(finishes):
106	        gs = evt.get("globalStep", 0)
107	        step_to_indices.setdefault(gs, []).append(idx)
108	
109	    tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = []
110	    for idx, tf in enumerate(finishes):
111	        gs = tf.get("globalStep", 0)
112	        cid = tf.get("toolCallId", "")
113	
114	        # Token delta: how much the context window grew after this step
115	        curr = step_map.get(gs)
116	        nxt = step_map.get(gs + 1)
117	        token_delta = max(0, nxt.input_tokens - curr.input_tokens) if curr and nxt else 0
118	
119	        tok = finish_tokens[idx]
120	        parallel_indices = step_to_indices.get(gs, [idx])
121	        total_parallel_tok = sum(finish_tokens[i] for i in parallel_indices)
122	        weight = (tok / total_parallel_tok) if total_parallel_tok > 0 else (
123	            1.0 / len(parallel_indices)
124	        )
125	
126	        output_text = to_str(tf.get("output", ""))
127	        tool_calls.append(ToolCall(
128	            name=tf.get("tool", ""),
129	            input=tf.get("args", {}),
130	            output=output_text,
131	            is_error=bool(tf.get("isError", False)),
132	            turn_no=gs,
133	            call_idx=idx,
134	            tiktoken_tokens=tok,
135	            output_chars=tf.get("outputSize", 0) or len(output_text),
136	            duration_ms=tf.get("duration", 0) or 0,
137	            allotted_tokens=round(token_delta * weight),
138	        ))
139	
140	    return tool_calls
141	
142	
143	# 真实 opencode 并不会发出独立的 subagent.spawn 事件（插件里监听
144	# message.part.updated 的 agent/subtask part 分支在实际运行中从未触发过）。
145	# 子代理的派发在真实 trace 里只是一次普通的 task 工具调用：
146	#   tool.start / tool.finish，tool == "task"
147	# 子会话 ID 只出现在 tool.finish.output 的自由文本里，形如：
148	#   <task id="ses_xxx" state="completed">...
149	# 需要正则提取。
150	_TASK_RESULT_RE = re.compile(r'<task\s+id="([^"]+)"\s+state="([^"]*)"')
151	
152	
153	def _extract_subagents(events: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
154	    """从 task 工具调用中还原子代理派发信息，兼容旧的 subagent.spawn 事件。
155	
156	    注意：真实数据里 tool.start / tool.finish 的 toolCallId 经常对不上——插件在
157	    缺少显式 ID 时用 `Date.now()` 兜底生成，start 和 finish 取到的是两个不同
158	    时刻，因此不能按 ID 配对 task 的起止。这里改用 FIFO 顺序配对：task 调用
159	    绝大多数场景下是"派发-阻塞等待完成"的顺序模式，不会大量并发交错，顺序
160	    配对足够可靠；配对结果仅用于估算父侧观测到的派发耗时，不影响子会话 ID
161	    的提取（那部分始终来自 finish.output 的正则匹配）。
162	    """
163	    pending_starts: deque[dict[str, Any]] = deque()
164	    subagents: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
165	    seen_child_ids: set[str] = set()
166	
167	    for evt in events:
168	        etype = evt.get("type")
169	        if etype == "tool.start" and evt.get("tool") == "task":
170	            pending_starts.append(evt)
171	            continue
172	        if etype != "tool.finish" or evt.get("tool") != "task":
173	            continue
174	
175	        start_evt = pending_starts.popleft() if pending_starts else None
176	        args = evt.get("args") or {}
177	        output = to_str(evt.get("output", ""))
178	        m = _TASK_RESULT_RE.search(output)
179	        child_id = m.group(1) if m else ""
180	        state = m.group(2) if m else ("error" if evt.get("isError") else "unknown")
181	
182	        duration_ms = None
183	        if start_evt is not None:
184	            duration_ms = max(0, evt.get("ts", 0) - start_evt.get("ts", 0))
185	
186	        if child_id:
187	            seen_child_ids.add(child_id)
188	        subagents.append({
189	            "childSessionID": child_id,
190	            "agentName": str(args.get("subagent_type", "")),
191	            "description": str(args.get("description", "")),
192	            "state": state,
193	            "globalStep": evt.get("globalStep", 0),
194	            "ts": evt.get("ts", 0),
195	            "dispatchDurationMs": duration_ms,
196	        })
197	
198	    # 还在进行中的 task 调用（只有 start，没有 finish）：拿不到子会话 ID
199	    # （ID 只出现在 finish 的输出里），但仍应让用户知道"有一次派发还未完成"，
200	    # 而不是让它凭空消失。
201	    for start_evt in pending_starts:
202	        args = start_evt.get("args") or {}
203	        subagents.append({
204	            "childSessionID": "",
205	            "agentName": str(args.get("subagent_type", "")),
206	            "description": str(args.get("description", "")),
207	            "state": "running",
208	            "globalStep": start_evt.get("globalStep", 0),
209	            "ts": start_evt.get("ts", 0),
210	            "dispatchDurationMs": None,
211	        })
212	
213	    # 向后兼容：如果某个环境的插件确实发出了 subagent.spawn（例如未来版本
214	    # 修好了 message.part.updated 的那个分支），也一并纳入，按 childSessionID

"""Parser for Opencode trace-logger `.ndjson` files.

Key algorithm: weight-based token allotment.
  When multiple tools run in the same globalStep, the input-token delta
  for that step is distributed among them proportionally by their
  tiktoken output size.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from collections import deque
from typing import Any

import streamlit as st

from trace_viz.models import ParseResult, ResultInfo, SessionInfo, ToolCall, Turn
from trace_viz.utils import count_tokens, to_str


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def parse(content: bytes) -> ParseResult:
    """Parse Opencode NDJSON content and return a structured ParseResult."""
    raw_events = _load_ndjson(content)
    if not raw_events:
        return ParseResult.empty("opencode")

    session_info = _extract_session_info(raw_events)
    turns = _extract_turns(raw_events)
    tool_calls = _extract_tool_calls(raw_events, turns)
    result_info = _build_result_info(raw_events, turns)
    subagents = _extract_subagents(raw_events)

    return ParseResult(
        source="opencode",
        raw_events=raw_events,
        session_info=session_info,
        result_info=result_info,
        turns=turns,
        tool_calls=tool_calls,
        subagents=subagents,
    )


# ── Private helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────

def _load_ndjson(content: bytes) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    events: list[dict] = []
    for line in content.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            try:
                events.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                pass
    return events


def _extract_session_info(events: list[dict]) -> SessionInfo:
    for evt in events:
        if evt.get("type") == "session.start":
            return SessionInfo(
                model=evt.get("model", ""),
                session_id=evt.get("sessionID", ""),
                title=evt.get("title", ""),
            )
    return SessionInfo()


def _extract_turns(events: list[dict]) -> list[Turn]:
    turns: list[Turn] = []
    for evt in events:
        if evt.get("type") != "step.finish":
            continue
        turns.append(Turn(
            turn_no=evt["globalStep"],
            input_tokens=evt["cumTokens"]["input"],
            output_tokens=evt["cumTokens"]["output"],
            reasoning_tokens=evt["tokens"].get("reasoning", 0),
            cache_read=evt["tokens"].get("cacheRead", 0),
            cache_creation=evt["tokens"].get("cacheWrite", 0),
            stop_reason=evt.get("reason", ""),
        ))
    return turns


def _extract_tool_calls(
    events: list[dict], turns: list[Turn]
) -> list[ToolCall]:
    # Build lookup maps
    step_map: dict[int, Turn] = {t.turn_no: t for t in turns}
    tool_start_map: dict[str, dict] = {
        e["toolCallId"]: e for e in events if e.get("type") == "tool.start"
    }
    finishes = [e for e in events if e.get("type") == "tool.finish"]

    # Pre-compute tiktoken tokens per finish event (needed for weight calculation)
    finish_tokens: list[int] = [
        count_tokens(to_str(e.get("output", ""))) for e in finishes
    ]

    # Group finish indices by globalStep for parallel-tool weighting
    step_to_indices: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
    for idx, evt in enumerate(finishes):
        gs = evt.get("globalStep", 0)
        step_to_indices.setdefault(gs, []).append(idx)

    tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = []
    for idx, tf in enumerate(finishes):
        gs = tf.get("globalStep", 0)
        cid = tf.get("toolCallId", "")

        # Token delta: how much the context window grew after this step
        curr = step_map.get(gs)
        nxt = step_map.get(gs + 1)
        token_delta = max(0, nxt.input_tokens - curr.input_tokens) if curr and nxt else 0

        tok = finish_tokens[idx]
        parallel_indices = step_to_indices.get(gs, [idx])
        total_parallel_tok = sum(finish_tokens[i] for i in parallel_indices)
        weight = (tok / total_parallel_tok) if total_parallel_tok > 0 else (
            1.0 / len(parallel_indices)
        )

        output_text = to_str(tf.get("output", ""))
        tool_calls.append(ToolCall(
            name=tf.get("tool", ""),
            input=tf.get("args", {}),
            output=output_text,
            is_error=bool(tf.get("isError", False)),
            turn_no=gs,
            call_idx=idx,
            tiktoken_tokens=tok,
            output_chars=tf.get("outputSize", 0) or len(output_text),
            duration_ms=tf.get("duration", 0) or 0,
            allotted_tokens=round(token_delta * weight),
        ))

    return tool_calls


# 真实 opencode 并不会发出独立的 subagent.spawn 事件（插件里监听
# message.part.updated 的 agent/subtask part 分支在实际运行中从未触发过）。
# 子代理的派发在真实 trace 里只是一次普通的 task 工具调用：
#   tool.start / tool.finish，tool == "task"
# 子会话 ID 只出现在 tool.finish.output 的自由文本里，形如：
#   <task id="ses_xxx" state="completed">...
# 需要正则提取。
_TASK_RESULT_RE = re.compile(r'<task\s+id="([^"]+)"\s+state="([^"]*)"')


def _extract_subagents(events: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """从 task 工具调用中还原子代理派发信息，兼容旧的 subagent.spawn 事件。

    注意：真实数据里 tool.start / tool.finish 的 toolCallId 经常对不上——插件在
    缺少显式 ID 时用 `Date.now()` 兜底生成，start 和 finish 取到的是两个不同
    时刻，因此不能按 ID 配对 task 的起止。这里改用 FIFO 顺序配对：task 调用
    绝大多数场景下是"派发-阻塞等待完成"的顺序模式，不会大量并发交错，顺序
    配对足够可靠；配对结果仅用于估算父侧观测到的派发耗时，不影响子会话 ID
    的提取（那部分始终来自 finish.output 的正则匹配）。
    """
    pending_starts: deque[dict[str, Any]] = deque()
    subagents: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen_child_ids: set[str] = set()

    for evt in events:
        etype = evt.get("type")
        if etype == "tool.start" and evt.get("tool") == "task":
            pending_starts.append(evt)
            continue
        if etype != "tool.finish" or evt.get("tool") != "task":
            continue

        start_evt = pending_starts.popleft() if pending_starts else None
        args = evt.get("args") or {}
        output = to_str(evt.get("output", ""))
        m = _TASK_RESULT_RE.search(output)
        child_id = m.group(1) if m else ""
        state = m.group(2) if m else ("error" if evt.get("isError") else "unknown")

        duration_ms = None
        if start_evt is not None:
            duration_ms = max(0, evt.get("ts", 0) - start_evt.get("ts", 0))

        if child_id:
            seen_child_ids.add(child_id)
        subagents.append({
            "childSessionID": child_id,
            "agentName": str(args.get("subagent_type", "")),
            "description": str(args.get("description", "")),
            "state": state,
            "globalStep": evt.get("globalStep", 0),
            "ts": evt.get("ts", 0),
            "dispatchDurationMs": duration_ms,
        })

    # 还在进行中的 task 调用（只有 start，没有 finish）：拿不到子会话 ID
    # （ID 只出现在 finish 的输出里），但仍应让用户知道"有一次派发还未完成"，
    # 而不是让它凭空消失。
    for start_evt in pending_starts:
        args = start_evt.get("args") or {}
        subagents.append({
            "childSessionID": "",
            "agentName": str(args.get("subagent_type", "")),
            "description": str(args.get("description", "")),
            "state": "running",
            "globalStep": start_evt.get("globalStep", 0),
            "ts": start_evt.get("ts", 0),
            "dispatchDurationMs": None,
        })

    # 向后兼容：如果某个环境的插件确实发出了 subagent.spawn（例如未来版本
    # 修好了 message.part.updated 的那个分支），也一并纳入，按 childSessionID
    # 去重，避免同一个子会话被展示两次。
    for evt in events:
        if evt.get("type") != "subagent.spawn":
            continue
        cid = evt.get("childSessionID", "")
        if cid and cid in seen_child_ids:
            continue
        if cid:
            seen_child_ids.add(cid)
        subagents.append({
            "childSessionID": cid,
            "agentName": evt.get("agentName", ""),
            "description": "",
            "state": "unknown",
            "globalStep": evt.get("globalStep", 0),
            "ts": evt.get("ts", 0),
            "dispatchDurationMs": None,
        })

    return subagents


def _build_result_info(events: list[dict], turns: list[Turn]) -> ResultInfo:
    info = ResultInfo(num_turns=len(turns))

    for evt in events:
        if evt.get("type") == "session.end":
            ti = evt.get("totalTokens", {})
            info.total_input = ti.get("input", 0)
            info.total_output = ti.get("output", 0)
            break

    if not info.total_input and turns:
        info.total_input = turns[-1].input_tokens
        info.total_output = turns[-1].output_tokens

    if len(events) >= 2:
        info.duration_ms = events[-1]["ts"] - events[0]["ts"]

    return info

579	def _iter_content(raw_content: object) -> list[dict]:
580	    """Normalise a content field into a list of dicts.
581	
582	    In transcript JSONL the content may arrive as:
583	      - a plain string          → wrap as {"type":"text","text":...}
584	      - a list of dicts         → return as-is (filter out non-dicts)
585	      - a list of strings       → wrap each as {"type":"text","text":...}
586	    """
587	    if isinstance(raw_content, str):
588	        return [{"type": "text", "text": raw_content}]
589	    if not isinstance(raw_content, list):
590	        return []
591	    out = []
592	    for item in raw_content:
593	        if isinstance(item, dict):
594	            out.append(item)
595	        elif isinstance(item, str):
596	            out.append({"type": "text", "text": item})
597	    return out

600	def _build_mermaid(events: list[dict], *, is_transcript: bool) -> str:
601	    lines = [
602	        "sequenceDiagram", "    autonumber",
603	        "    participant U as User",
604	        "    participant A as Claude",
605	        "    participant T as Tool",
606	    ]
607	
608	    for evt in events:
609	        if not isinstance(evt, dict):
610	            continue
611	        etype = evt.get("type", "")
612	        ts    = ""
613	        if is_transcript and evt.get("timestamp"):
614	            try:
615	                ts = " " + datetime.fromisoformat(
616	                    evt["timestamp"].replace("Z", "+00:00")
617	                ).strftime("%H:%M:%S")
618	            except Exception:
619	                pass
620	
621	        if etype == "system":
622	            model = evt.get("model", "Claude")
623	            lines.append(f"    Note over U,T: 会话初始化 model={sanitize_mermaid(model, 28)}")
624	
625	        elif etype == "assistant":
626	            msg = evt.get("message") or {}
627	            if not isinstance(msg, dict):
628	                continue
629	            usage = msg.get("usage") or {}
630	            in_t  = usage.get("input_tokens", "")
631	            out_t = usage.get("output_tokens", "")
632	            tok_s = f"in={in_t} out={out_t}" if in_t else ""
633	            lines.append(f"    Note over A: {mermaid_quote('LLM推理 ' + tok_s + ts)}")
634	
635	            for block in _iter_content(msg.get("content", [])):
636	                btype = block.get("type", "")
637	                if btype == "text":
638	                    txt = sanitize_mermaid(block.get("text", ""), 60)
639	                    if txt:
640	                        lines.append(f"    A->>U: {mermaid_quote(txt)}")
641	                elif btype == "tool_use":
642	                    name = sanitize_mermaid(block.get("name", "tool"), 25)
643	                    inp  = block.get("input") or {}
644	                    hint = sanitize_mermaid(
645	                        to_str(next(iter(inp.values()), "")) if inp else "", 32
646	                    )
647	                    label = name + (f"({hint})" if hint else "")
648	                    lines.append(f"    A->>+T: {mermaid_quote(label)}")
649	
650	        elif etype == "user":
651	            # Both stream-json and transcript: tool_result nested in user message
652	            msg = evt.get("message") or {}
653	            if not isinstance(msg, dict):
654	                continue
655	            has_tool_result = False
656	            for block in _iter_content(msg.get("content", [])):
657	                btype = block.get("type", "")
658	                if btype == "tool_result":
659	                    has_tool_result = True
660	                    raw = block.get("content", "")
661	                    content_str = "\n".join(
662	                        (c.get("text", str(c)) if isinstance(c, dict) else str(c))
663	                        for c in raw
664	                    ) if isinstance(raw, list) else to_str(raw)
665	                    err   = " [ERROR]" if block.get("is_error") else ""
666	                    label = sanitize_mermaid(content_str or "done", 50) + err
667	                    lines.append(f"    T-->>-A: {mermaid_quote(label + ts)}")
668	                elif btype == "text" and not has_tool_result:
669	                    txt = sanitize_mermaid(block.get("text", ""), 60)
670	                    if txt:
671	                        lines.append(f"    U->>A: {mermaid_quote(txt + ts)}")
672	
673	        elif etype == "tool_result":
674	            # Keep for safety: some future versions may emit top-level tool_result
675	            content = evt.get("content", "")
676	            if isinstance(content, list):
677	                content = " ".join(
678	                    (c.get("text", str(c)) if isinstance(c, dict) else str(c))
679	                    for c in content
680	                )
681	            err   = " [ERROR]" if evt.get("isError") else ""
682	            label = sanitize_mermaid(to_str(content or "done"), 50) + err
683	            lines.append(f"    T-->>-A: {mermaid_quote(label + ts)}")
684	
685	        elif etype == "result":
686	            parts = ["任务完成"]

688	            dur  = evt.get("duration_ms", 0)
689	            cost = evt.get("total_cost_usd", 0)

693	                except (TypeError, ValueError): pass
694	            if cost:
695	                try: parts.append(f"${float(cost):.4f}")
696	                except (TypeError, ValueError): pass
697	            lines.append(f"    A->>U: {mermaid_quote(' '.join(parts))}")
698	
699	    return "\n".join(lines)

"""Claude Code visualization view.

Supports two data sources:
  1. stream-json file  — `claude -p "task" --output-format stream-json > trace.ndjson`
  2. transcript JSONL  — auto-saved to ~/.claude/projects/<hash>/<session>.jsonl
                         during every interactive terminal session (no setup needed)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import streamlit as st

from trace_viz.config import SAFE_PALETTE
from trace_viz.models import ParseResult
from trace_viz.parsers.claude_code import parse
from trace_viz.utils import format_duration, mermaid_quote, sanitize_mermaid, to_str
from trace_viz.views.replay import claude_code_to_replay_steps, render_replay
from trace_viz.views.shared import (
    mermaid_controls,
    raw_events_tab,
    render_mermaid,
    sample_events,
    token_delta_fig,
    token_trend_fig,
    tool_efficiency_table,
    tool_inspector,
    tool_success_rate,
    tool_tiktoken_fig,
)

# ── Transcript root ────────────────────────────────────────────
_TRANSCRIPT_ROOT = Path.home() / ".claude" / "projects"


def render() -> None:
    """Standalone entry point: picks a data source via the sidebar, then renders it."""
    result = _sidebar()
    if result is None:
        _show_quickstart()
        return
    render_body(result)


def render_body(result: ParseResult) -> None:
    """Renders an already-parsed result, shared by the standalone and embedded flows."""
    df_tools = _build_tools_df(result)

    _sidebar_meta(result)
    _metrics_row(result, df_tools)
    st.markdown("---")

    is_transcript = result.parse_debug.get("format") == "transcript"

def _sidebar_transcript() -> ParseResult | None:
    """Browse ~/.claude/projects/ and let the user pick a session."""
    with st.sidebar:
        custom_root = st.text_input(
            "transcript 目录",
            str(_TRANSCRIPT_ROOT),
            key="cc_root",
        )
        root = Path(custom_root)

        if not root.exists():
            st.warning(f"目录不存在：`{root}`")
            return None

        # Collect all JSONL files, sorted newest-first
        all_files = sorted(
            root.rglob("*.jsonl"),
            key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime,
            reverse=True,
        )
        if not all_files:
            st.info("未找到 `.jsonl` 文件，请确认路径。")
            return None

        # Build display labels: "<project-dir> / <filename>  (date)"
        def _label(p: Path) -> str:
            try:
                rel   = p.relative_to(root)
                mtime = datetime.fromtimestamp(p.stat().st_mtime)
                size  = p.stat().st_size
                return f"{rel.parent.name[:20]}/{p.stem[:18]}  {mtime:%m-%d %H:%M}  {size//1024}KB"
            except Exception:
                return str(p)

        labels      = [_label(p) for p in all_files]
        chosen_label = st.selectbox(
            f"选择会话（共 {len(all_files)} 个）",
            labels,
            key="cc_session_sel",
        )
        chosen_path = all_files[labels.index(chosen_label)]
        st.caption(str(chosen_path))

        if st.button("加载此会话", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state["cc_content"] = chosen_path.read_bytes()
            st.session_state.pop("cc_result", None)
            st.rerun()

        content = st.session_state.get("cc_content")
        if content is None:
            return None

        if "cc_result" not in st.session_state:
            with st.spinner("解析中…"):
                st.session_state["cc_result"] = parse(content)

        return st.session_state.get("cc_result")


def _sidebar_upload() -> ParseResult | None:
    """Accept a manually uploaded JSONL / NDJSON file."""
    with st.sidebar:
        uploaded = st.file_uploader(

            type=["ndjson", "jsonl", "txt", "json"],
